title: LUHMES Culturing and Differentiation Protocol
author: Mallory Wright
materials: Poly-L- Ornithine Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #A-004-C 0.1 mg/mL, Stock concentration 50 µg/µL, Working concentration Thaw an aliquot of Poly-L-Ornithine solution at room temperature.
Neutralize trypsin with 6mL of pre-warmed DMEM/F12

DMEM/F12 Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11320033 Penicillin Streptomycin (10,000 U/mL) Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15140122 B-27 Supplement (50X) Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #17504044 Recombinant Human FGF basic/FGF2/bFGF (145 aa) Protein, CF R&D Systems Catalog #3718-FB Add recombinant human FGF to media after seeding cells **See material section for media concentration information**

Fibronectin human plasma,liquid, 0.1% (Solution), Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #F0895-1MG Storage: –20 °C in aliquots 1 mg/mL, Stock Concentration 2 µg/µL, Working concentration Thaw an aliquot of Fibronectin solution at 5°C . Do not vortex or shake vigorously to resuspend the fibronectin. This will cause the fibronectin to “crash” out of solution, which is irreversible

steps.title: Prepare fibronectin coating
steps.instruction: Dilute fibronectin in sterile HBSS by adding 2 µL fibronectin to 998 µL HBSS.

steps.title: Coat flask with fibronectin
steps.instruction: Add the diluted fibronectin to the flask, rinse the flask three times with HBSS, air‑dry the flask for 15 minutes, then add fresh LUHMES growth media.

steps.title: Prepare Poly‑L‑Ornithine coating
steps.instruction: Dilute Poly‑L‑Ornithine to 50 µg/mL in nuclease‑free water by mixing 500 µL PLO with 500 µL water; add 7 mL of this solution to a T‑75 flask and incubate overnight at room temperature; rinse the flask three times with nuclease‑free water; allow the flask to air‑dry for 15 minutes uncapped in the hood with the UV light on.

steps.title: Add fresh media before seeding
steps.instruction: Add fresh culture media to the newly coated flask and incubate for at least 15 minutes to allow the media to reach normal pH before seeding cells.

steps.title: Incubate fibronectin‑coated flask
steps.instruction: Place the fibronectin‑coated flask in the incubator for 3 hours.

steps.title: Passage LUHMES cells
steps.instruction: Use a 5 mL pipette to triturate cells 1–2 times; discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL LUHMES growth media; transfer the suspension to a 15 mL tube and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 1200 RPM; add 4 mL pre‑warmed 0.025 % Trypsin/EDTA (Thermo Scientific catalog #R001100) and incubate in the incubator for 3 minutes; remove the trypsin solution and rinse the cells with DPBS.

steps.title: Routine media change
steps.instruction: Change pre‑warmed media every 1–2 days; always use fresh DMEM/F12 because the HEPES buffer photo‑oxidizes to hydrogen peroxide.

steps.title: Cryopreserve cells
steps.instruction: Label 2 mL cryovials with date, name, FIV#, Qbench number, passage number and cell type; prepare freezing media consisting of 7 mL LUHMES media, 4 µL B‑FGF (40 ng), 2 mL FBS (20 %), and 1 mL DMSO (1 %); add ~1.5 × 10⁶ cells per vial in 1 mL freezing media and freeze.

steps.title: Start differentiation (Day 0)
steps.instruction: When LUHMES are 80 % confluent, add differentiation media and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Replate for differentiation (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Replate cells onto a new poly‑L‑ornithine and fibronectin‑coated plate at a density of 1 × 10⁶ cells per T‑75 flask or approximately 4 × 10⁵ cells per well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Maintain differentiation
steps.instruction: Replace LUHMES differentiation media daily; cells mature into dopamine‑like neurons by day 7.
